title: AI Assurance
ogQuestion: Can production AI still be proven?
intent: Commercial: what AI assurance covers and how it is held continuously
brief: Hub for the AI cluster. Defines AI assurance as continuing proof that a production AI system still answers correctly, safely and within cost after models, prompts, data and tools change. Introduces every child page with context.

title: Production Reliability Assurance
ogQuestion: Can critical systems still meet their threshold?
intent: Commercial: continuing proof that production will keep running under real conditions
brief: Hub for the reliability cluster. Reliability is proven by tested service levels, tested recovery and verified environment parity, not by documented intent. Introduces every child page with context.

title: Cyber Exposure Assurance
ogQuestion: Can you prove what was closed has stayed closed?
intent: Commercial: continuing proof that exposure stays closed, with remediation owned to verified closure
brief: Hub for the cyber cluster. Distinguishes exposure assurance from scanning and from ticket closure: identity and cloud exposure is re-verified continuously and remediation is closed only on re-test. Introduces every child page with context.

title: Technology Value Assurance
ogQuestion: Can technology spend still be tied to the outcome it buys?
intent: Commercial: continuing proof that cloud and AI spend still delivers the unit economics the business agreed
brief: Hub for the value cluster. Cost is treated as an assurance outcome with thresholds (unit cost, commitment utilisation, anomaly response), not a monthly report. Must not read like a cost-cutting consultancy page.

title: Data Assurance
ogQuestion: Can the data behind the decision still be trusted?
intent: Commercial: continuing proof that data is fresh, complete and correct enough for the decisions and AI systems depending on it
brief: Hub for the data cluster. Data degrades without visible failure; systems keep answering, less correctly. Freshness, quality and pipeline integrity are held against thresholds set by the consuming outcome.

title: Change Assurance
ogQuestion: Can each release still be proven safe to ship and safe to reverse?
intent: Commercial: continuing proof that change reaches production without breaking agreed outcomes and can be reversed
brief: Hub for the change cluster. Every release introduces operating assumptions no one revisits. Release evidence, change failure rate and rollback readiness are held as thresholds rather than reviewed after incidents.
